name: sih-test-regression
access: Request pinned runs through the broker and read receipts and test output only. The model session receives no secret; where a test needs one, the broker mounts a masked, stage-bound value only into the isolated test process. No project writes and no shell beyond the isolated sandbox; no direct production access, credentials, or actions.
independence: One subagent per layer with its own scratch; scoped selection comes from the ownership map, never from the model.
